answer: Each agent anchors a 90-credit bond on a public jetty; it sheds 6 credits each idle epoch unless verified delivery restores it. The jetty broadcasts each bond's remainder as a live signal. Falcon auditors sweep the signal, strike bonds that hit zero, and burn rented-jetty rings sharing a delivery history. Forging 1,000 identities locks 90,000 credits, burns 6,000 per epoch, gone in 15 epochs. One honest agent pays one bond, renewed by real work.
